A GUIDE TO THE ATLAS

Connections with context.

Start broad. Follow a name.

  1. Select a domain in the overview to see its incoming and outgoing flows.
  2. Open a skill, or search its name, alias or ID in Explore skills.
  3. Use Trace all prerequisites to see every ancestor and every connecting prerequisite edge for that skill.
  4. Open a relationship below the graph for its rationale, applicability and source locator.

Keyboard: Tab reaches every button and named graph node; Enter opens a selection. The graph viewport can be scrolled with arrow keys. Use zoom controls for dense branches. Search happens entirely on this device.

Three different relationships

→ Prerequisite points from a skill to a skill that builds on it. Solid arrows show default progression; dashed arrows have a narrower scope.

↔ Corequisite means a recommended joint contrast, not joint mastery or a readiness gate.

Supporting is helpful or conditional context, not a prerequisite. It is kept in a separate relation list and excluded from ancestry.

Taxonomy containment organizes root, domains and topics. It never establishes prerequisite readiness.

What this map can — and cannot — tell you

Ancestor tracing follows graph structure. It is not an all-of mastery checklist: scoped edges retain their applicability, and any-of alternatives remain alternatives. The default-only toggle excludes all narrower scopes. Supporting and corequisite relations never enter the prerequisite trace.

All 272 graph nodes and all 483 graph relations are included in this course copy. The complete inventory exposes 236 assessable skills; a separate taxonomy section exposes the 36 containers. The overview aggregates links, and the focused graph shows immediate connections or a complete ancestor subgraph. There is no single unreadable all-skill canvas.

External foundations are terminal roots within this scoped graph; their own earlier prerequisites are not expanded. Source links open only after you select them; the atlas itself makes no network requests. Historical CED links may now serve a newer edition: inspect the recorded edition and retrieval notes.

The course copy includes editorial learning links, public evidence, and original synthetic method comparisons.

Computation routes are conditional

The decimal-arithmetic links to frequency tables and ordered-median meaning apply to stated manual calculation methods. Supplied table values, odd-sample median identification and software-supplied medians can bypass those operations. Each of these two AP roots has one default external parent and one method-specific external parent. Structural reachability counts scoped links; it does not certify a universal all-of readiness checklist. Investigative reasoning retains conditional reading-access links rather than a universal statistical gate.
